text:
Alex: FYI — SDK v1.7 is published (npm & PyPI). Docs site has a coordinated refresh. Breaking change heads-up: the default streaming protocol is switching from 'plain-text' to 'chunked-json' to support structured events. Older plain-text streaming will be removed on 2024-08-01. Migration guide: https://redwood.internal/docs/sdk/migration-v1-7 (internal)
devrel-bot: Release published: packages: @redwood/sdk@1.7.0, redwood-sdk==1.7.0. Changelog: https://redwood.internal/release/1.7
Sam: Quick question — will the runtime accept both formats until 8/1 or is this a hard cut? (we need an infra plan for safety)
Alex: Good q. Sam/Eng — we will accept both until deprecation date. After that we will return 410 for plain-text streams. Expect a 2-week advance notice before the hard cut if any schedule shifts.
Claire: Docs update done: Quickstart + Chat Streaming examples now show chunked-json by default. I added a Migration FAQ section and a short snippet showing the client-side parser: ```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
for event in c.stream(...):
    if event.type == 'message':
        print(event.data['text'])
```
Link to docs diff: https://redwood.internal/docs/diff/sdk-1.7

Mike: Can we get a small snippet for the JS SDK too? I'll add it to the public quickstart. Also, we need a callout on the onboarding wizard so new users don't default to the deprecated flag.
Alex: Added a JS snippet in the docs and a TODO on the onboarding ticket. JS example: ```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const c = new Redwood()
for await (const ev of c.stream({})) {
  if (ev.type === 'message') console.log(ev.data.text)
}
``` 
Liz: Heads-up sent to CS & Sales with the deprecation timeline and suggested customer messaging. Recommending we proactively reach out to any accounts using streaming-heavy workloads.
eng-oncall: We'll add a temporary alert to the streaming parser errors dashboard. If plain-text ingestion errors > 1% we will page the runtime team. Monitoring window: rolling 5m.
Sam: Thanks. One more: are we changing any auth headers or response shapes? If so, we need migration tests.
Alex: No auth header changes in v1.7. Response envelope slightly extended for structured events (new "type" and "meta"). Migration guide includes example test cases; recommend adding them to the SDK integration test suite.
Claire: I'll add a short checklist for docs reviewers and tag the QA runbook.
Mike: I updated the public CHANGELOG with a short 'breaking change' callout and examples. Also added a code snippet for quick patch to keep old behavior: `client.stream({ protocol: 'plain-text' })` — this will be removed on 2024-08-01.
Alex: Thanks everyone. Action items: Sam/Eng confirm runtime dual-mode for the next 3 months (assigned), Claire finish QA checklist, Mike update onboarding text, Liz coordinate customer comms. Ping me if you spot anything in staging. :rocket:
